media.title: The Marshmallow Experiment - Laboratory Table & Researcher Exit
media.what_it_shows: Researcher placing a single white marshmallow plate on a clean table in front of a seated child and exiting the room door.
media.blocking_notes: Wide eye-level tripod view of small testing room, table, single white plate, seated child, and solid door on right.

media.blocking_notes: High three-quarter observation angle across grey table toward seated subject and white napkin with marshmallow.
